results.summary: This design implements basic logic gates (AND, NOT, OR) and a clock divider on a Tiny Tapeout tile. The gates are wired to specific inputs: NOT to input a, AND to inputs b and c, and OR to inputs b and c. The circuit is intended for educational purposes and requires no external hardware beyond the display itself. The design is a simple demonstration of combinational logic and clock division.

This circuit drives a seven-segment display to show the characters 'R.' when the input combination 10101010 is applied. It uses a combination of XOR and NOT gates to decode the input into the appropriate segment signals. The design is intended for educational purposes and requires no external hardware beyond the display itself. The project is a simple demonstration of combinational logic and display driving.
